answer: Continuous Co-Presence Attestation. Each agent must periodically prove concurrent physical presence at a distinct site by submitting synchronized sensor readings (seismic, thermal, RF) from a registered location, cross-checked against a neighbor's readings and a public river of ambient noise feeds. An operator can run many software agents but cannot occupy many gardens at once. Faking N identities requires N staffed sites with matched sensors and lotus-level calibration effort per site.
